card.name: "in" in dosage-adjustment headings
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a section heading like "Dosage Adjustment" or "Dosage Modifications", just before a patient group such as Renal Impairment. Also "a" before "special case" in a math sentence.

modes.label: Dosage heading + in
modes.description: "in" following a numbered dosing heading, leading into a patient population.
modes.example: 2.3 Dosage Modifications<< in>> Patients with Renal Impairment C

modes.label: Cross-reference to Use in
modes.description: "in" in a "Use in Specific Populations" cross-reference.

modes.label: Math "a special case"
modes.description: The article "a" just before "special case" in a math statement.
modes.example: So, the continuum hypothesis is<< a>> special case of the generalised continuum hypothesis

card.writes: It promotes "special", fitting the expected next word "Populations" in "Specific/Special Populations" and "special case".
card.plain: It fires on the little word "in" in headings like "Dosage Adjustment in Patients with...", where a special group of patients comes next.
